About Youssef · synthetic at the edges, human at the core

Two decades where technology, policy and commerce meet.

Why: I believe the most powerful technology of our lifetime shouldn’t be rented from someone who can read it. Everything below is how I earned the right to say that.

I'm a technology entrepreneur and venture builder. I started in 2005 in Beirut as a digital strategist and managing partner, leading transformation programmes for governments, banks and universities. I then moved from advising on companies to building them: an accelerator, an insurtech platform, a medtech wearable, and, more recently, AI products and an enterprise AI consultancy.

Today I run Inova AI Solutions from Sydney and Dubai, advise Acalia City, a large-scale smart city development in Mexico, on technology architecture and capital raising, and work with boards and executive teams on how to adopt AI without losing control of it.
